description: A --header replaces the pact's header of the same name in a different case: the pact records 'authorization', the option names 'Authorization'. Today's verifier compares the names case-sensitively and sends the recorded token
source: staged plan S1.5; pact_verifier_cli's provider options, which janus verify spells the same way; ADR 0035; pact_verifier's create_native_request, which keeps a pact header the custom headers do not name exactly
